title: Decide where holdout expectations live
acceptance: The owner picks H1 (holdout expectations stay public and are reported as contamination-exposed) or H2 (holdout expectations move to an owner-held private store, the pack keeps a hash)
The choice and date are recorded in the record
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Owner answer recorded in the record
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Decided by the owner 2026-11-25: H1, holdout expectations stay public; the public holdouts are exposed examples, not real holdouts. H2 can be revisited when holdout scores are used to choose models. No actual: owner time not measured.
